title: Annual Conversion Charge, Professional Email Billing
content:
Billing calculation for the annual conversion of a Professional Email subscription on the monthly plan.

**Charge.** The annual conversion charge is the annual component less the conversion credit, rounded half up to the cent.

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Annual component | the converted seats times the annual seat price times 12, reduced by any rate that applies to it, rounded half up to the cent |
| Annual seat price | the product's annual-prepaid seat price |
| Converted seats | the seat count on the subscription |
| Conversion credit | the paid-month value less every fee taken off it, times the credit fraction, rounded half up to the cent |
| Credit fraction | the credited days so counted divided by the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date |

The paid-month value is the product's month-to-month seat price times the converted seats, no fee is taken off it, the annual start date is today, the credited days are the calendar days from today to the term end date, and no credit convention applies, so the credit fraction is 0.

## Worked example (hypothetical price and seats)

A monthly subscription with 26 seats and a hypothetical annual-prepaid seat price of 10.00: 26 times 10.00 times 12 is 3120.00, the annual component; the credit fraction is 0, so the conversion credit is 0.00 and the annual conversion charge is 3120.00, with the annual term starting today.
